title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
author: Mark Twain
summary: Tom Sawyer is a mischievous boy growing up beside the Mississippi, always scheming his way out of chores and into trouble. A graveyard witness, a hunt for buried treasure and a cave all bring him closer to real danger.
readIf: you want a funny, affectionate portrait of boyhood in a river town, with pranks, treasure hunts and a few real scares.
skipIf: you dislike period language, since the book carries racist terms and attitudes of its 1800s setting.

pairings.reason: Twain's follow-up, narrated by Tom's friend Huck, is deeper and sharper about the society around him.
Another boy's adventure story built on a map, buried treasure and a chilling villain.
A modern boy's adventure with buried treasure and a wry voice, aimed at a younger crowd.
